entity: Sabine Pass LNG terminal's greenhouse-gas rise, 2015-23
what_we_add: +6.08 Mt CO2e, rank 1 of 6,021 facilities reporting both years; next-biggest rise +2.90
why: EIP has Sabine Pass at 6.9M tons in 2023, most of any LNG terminal; Verite/Grist says it quickly became one of Louisiana's largest climate polluters. Same entity, same direction; nobody has the registry-wide biggest-rise rank. Cheniere's intensity claim is a different measure, not a contradiction.
